posts.title: JavaScript plotting tool for interactive plots
posts.description: I wrote another function plotter where you can write your function in simple JavaScript code. Something like func ( "f" , x => sin (x)) . No new special math-like syntax you have to learn, just JavaScript. Features: Plot updates each time you change the code Multiple plots Non-function objects like points, lines, rects and circles.
